indicator_rule: Indicators meet Gentry's test. Lists stay flat, not tiered by time (Grabo). Readouts count changed indicators per hypothesis; there is no weighted threat score. Area-specific frozen lists are private configuration.

indicators.text: A region reaches jamming scale on days in the last 7 and on none of the 30 before
indicators.rule: H3 res-2 region with 3+ res-4 cells at hex score >= 10 (>= 5 aircraft); new = in the last 7 days and none of the 30 before

indicators.text: A named area's severe share rises 5 points or more above its 30-day median
indicators.rule: today - median(previous 30 days) >= 5 percentage points, area share >= 5%

indicators.text: A fifth or more of aircraft heard over the area send no position
indicators.rule: position-loss share >= 20% where at least half the cells have MLAT coverage

indicators.text: Active spoofing episodes in or next to the area
indicators.rule: one or more active episodes within 350 km on the same day

indicators.text: A declared notice covers the area and time (US GPS test, official notice, EASA FIR listing)
indicators.rule: notice polygon or FIR intersects the region on the same day

indicators.text: Ionospheric scintillation moderate or strong over the area at the same hours
indicators.series: ESA scintillation nowcast; NOAA SWPC Kp
indicators.rule: nowcast level moderate or strong, or Kp >= 5, within 3 hours

indicators.text: Degraded reports come mostly from one receiver or one aircraft family
indicators.rule: more than 80% of degraded reports from one source

indicators.text: Aircraft coverage over the area falls more than 30% below its 28-day median
Satellite reflectometry (CYGNSS) shows a raised noise floor over the area
indicators.rule: cell noise floor above its own 90-day 95th percentile

warning_problems.title: New GPS interference area (anywhere on the map)
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a notice only when a region's watch condition changes; stay silent while it holds (ICD 203 allows silence for recurring products).
warning_problems.deactivation: A region returns to normal after 14 days with NF-IND-1 absent and coverage at or above half its median.

hypotheses.statement: Undeclared jamming or spoofing has begun

warning_problems.title: Escalation over a named area
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a notice when NF-IND-2 holds on 3 of the last 5 days, and again when it lapses.
warning_problems.deactivation: Back to normal when the area's share is within 5 points of its 30-day median for 7 days.

hypotheses.statement: Interference over the area has intensified

emerging_concerns: A region that reaches jamming scale but matches no warning problem goes to the review queue. It is promoted after it recurs in 3 separate weeks and demoted after 60 quiet days.
